Frames

Privacy policy

How this app handles data.

SupportPrivacy policyApp details ↗

Original policy updated October 7, 2026. Published on this site October 15, 2026.

Frames stores your notes on your device and does not require an account. Notes are not sent to the developer by the app. When you export or share a note, the destination you choose handles that content under its own privacy practices.

If you contact support, your email and the information you provide are used to respond to your request. Avoid including sensitive information that is not needed to explain the issue.

The hosting provider may process technical request information to serve this page.

For questions, contact support@mtk.sh.
